They don't - anchors are "dropped" in freefall, typically in known waters, meaning they know where the anchor will end up.

The anchor itself isn't the only thing that holds the ship in place - typically there is about 10x or more weight released in the anchor cable/chain that sits on the sea bed than just the anchor, and the combined weight holds the ship in place.
